The 3D reduction tests added in #197437 are failing on at least H100 and GB200, perhaps more devices. Each test has a different minor problem with expectations:
- `test_3d_reduction_with_broadcast_cuda` runs from TritonHostSideTMATestCUDA, which uses tensor_descriptor instead of block_ptr but inherits `block_descriptor_constructor_str = "tl.make_block_ptr"`
- `test_3d_reduction_descriptor_respects_tensor_rank_limit` needs higher tolerance, like already done in `test_3d_reduction_with_pointwise_output`
- `test_3d_reduction_with_pointwise_output` input is not 16-byte aligned, so only output uses a descriptor

This PR fixes these three issues- all tests now pass and no new failures are introduced.

Authored with assistance from agents

cc @voznesenskym @penguinwu @EikanWang @jgong5 @Guobing-Chen @XiaobingSuper @zhuhaozhe @blzheng @wenzhe-nrv @jiayisunx @ipiszy @kadeng @muchulee8 @amjames @chauhang @aakhundov @coconutruben @jataylo @eqy
